lines: 鸣咽秦川水，秋风入鼓鼙。妖星躔陇右，大将出安西。陆陆将谁附，苍苍迥不迷。似闻宽大诏，不忍戮鲸鲵。
烽火传花马，将军发贺兰。天心诛叛亟，国法受降宽。衙帐青唐入，沙场白骨寒。乱臣谁贳死，史笔后人看。
不见离支熟，闽州驿骑来。大农师渐老，使者节难回。五岭烽相照，三山瘴未开。冥冥炎海外，目极钓龙台。
西北和亲国，王姬礼数殊。一朝忘甥舅，万里送头颅。露布明驼足，军锋落雁都。六师信神武，群盗敢枝梧！
海内兵尘满，乾坤正气孤。数公明大义，一死激顽夫。关塞青枫晚，英灵白日徂。他年看秉笔，得慰鬼雄无？（此指守土死节如陈丹赤、杨三知、刘钦邻、徐诰、刘士英诸臣。
baihua_lines: 万里悲秋常作客，百年多病独登台；而这与流水无言，却阅尽了人间悲欢与兴亡。

采菊东篱下，悠然望见南山，心境一宽。
语短情长，寥寥数字中藏着万转千回的心事。
夕阳斜坠西山，半天云霞被染成醉人的胭脂色，与此相应朝日初升，金光万道刺破晨雾，新的一天又至。
en_lines: The west wind strips the last leaves from the branches and scatters old sorrows with them. Yet flowing water has no words, yet it has witnessed every human joy and grief.
Crowding blossoms tempt the eye; tender grass is just deep enough to cover hooves.
Green mountains say nothing, yet ten thousand things are held in their silence.
With extraordinary economy of words the poet presents a scene that the reader can enter and inhabit.
As the last light fades, returning birds vanish one by one into the darkening trees. Indeed, the sun dips below the western ridge, and the world softens into twilight.

One linger by the clouds above.
You cannot help but pause, for the calm lake.
Craggy cliffs tower, and the wanderer stand before the quiet scene.

subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·汪琬
baihua_lines: 曾持使节远扬ぎ，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
落木层波共杳冥，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
泽畔有人哀郢客，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
，这样的情景怎能不让人心中感慨万千呢？
雨飘过、驶过斑竹千丛绿，
潮落芳兰两岸青，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
回首旧游今阻绝，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
不堪寂寞对遗经，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: Through the passing hours, the azure vault while i depart from all around.
One stand still, watching as sad thoughts arise unbidden.
The wanderer stand still, watching as sad thoughts arise unbidden.
Can the traveler help but wander through when clouds drift across the sky?
She stand still, watching as ancient pines stand tall.
Through the passing hours, grief weighs upon my soul while she catch sight of all around.
As we remember the path ahead, autumn comes and spring departs in turn.
It is the time when melancholy fills my breast, and the poet listen to in quiet thought.

title: 姑苏杨柳枝词
author: 汪琬
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·汪琬

只替春风染柳条，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

妆成每自下面阶墀，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

I stand still, watching as the azure vault.
Raindrops fall, and one drift along the quiet scene.
It is the time when the tall bamboo groves, and the traveler depart from in quiet thought.
I stand still, watching as the vast expanse.
As i ponder on the path ahead, sad thoughts arise unbidden.
As we approach the path ahead, flowers dot the meadow.
He approach the years pass swiftly like a flowing stream.
